title: Free CC0 models, textures and skies from the CC0 Library, loaded and checked in Rust
note: For a common prop, surface or sky: cc0__search, then cc0__fetch at 1k; load the returned path in on_reset and check __render.missingModels stays absent.
intent: Before generating or modelling a common prop, surface or sky, look in the CC0 Library: cc0__search (kind model, texture or hdri) lists Poly Haven and ambientCG results with each source and id, and cc0__fetch puts one into assets/cc0/<job>/. Studio downloads it, checks its size and digests and records it as CC0-1.0 in genex-assets.lock: never download a file yourself, add a licence line or write a lock row. Fetch at the size it is seen at: 1k by default and on phones, 2k only for what fills the screen. A model arrives as one self-contained GLB: load it in on_reset with gfx.assets().model on the returned path without its leading assets/, draw it under a tag, and look at a capture: state().__render.missingModels must stay absent. A texture arrives as maps whose role (diff colour, nor_gl normal, arm occlusion, roughness and metalness) decides its usage at import, so it needs no [[texture]] row when a material samples it. A sky arrives as one .hdr for Environment::hdri. A curated pack that is held answers why: take a Poly Haven or ambientCG asset instead. Keep Powered by Poly Haven beside Poly Haven results you show the person.
port: The facet that places a prop fetches and loads it; another facet that needs the same asset reuses the path the first one loaded, never a second fetch.

evidence.note: cc0__search and cc0__fetch; Studio downloads and records CC0-1.0; a Poly Haven model is one self-contained GLB.
gfx.assets().model in on_reset; a model that did not load is named in state().__render.missingModels.
